author: Anthony Miranda
title: Bears Center Drew Dalman Retires From NFL At Age 27 - NewsBreak
text:
By Anthony Miranda ,
8 hours ago (GIF Courtesy Of GIPHY // Daveswerski) Bears Center Drew Dalman Retires From NFL At Age 27 The NFL is not just a season; it’s a year-long business. The Super Bowl wrapped up on February 8th, but the NFL is still in all the headlines. That is intentional as the NFL Combine has taken place from Feb 27 to March 2, and now NFL free agency will start March 11. Now, in shocking news, it appears the Bears center Drew Dalman will retire from the NFL. Chicago will now have to address the position in free agency or at the NFL Draft in April.
Drew Dalman was born in California and stayed in his home state by attending Stanford for college. He was selected in the 4th round of the 2021 NFL Draft by the Atlanta Falcons. He played for the Falcons for 4 years before signing with the Bears in free agency. This decision worked out for both sides, as last year the Bears made the playoffs for the first time since 2020. On the other hand, Drew Dalman was named to the Pro Bowl for the first time in his career.
Drew Dalman was coming off the best year of his career, and Chicago made it to the Divisional round with second-year QB Caleb Williams . It only makes sense to run everything back right? However, it seems Drew Dalman thinks otherwise as he retires at the age of 27. He was just one year into a three-year $42 million contract.
Now, his departure is extremely unfortunate for the Bears. However, some of his contract is voided, so Chicago will have some extra cap space now. Also, since he retired so early in the offseason, they will have the opportunity to address the center position in free agency or at the 2026 NFL Draft.
Los Angeles Rams trade for Trent McDuffie The Chicago Bears’ offensive line took a huge step last year, and Caleb Williams progressed with protection. Now, it will be interesting to see if the Bears can follow that trajectory or if they will struggle to find a new center. Finally, congratulations to Drew Dalman for making it to the NFL and for carrying the torch of Stanford players retiring very early in their careers.
